listingTitle: Keep a visible keyboard focus indicator
title: Keep a visible keyboard focus indicator
why: Removing the focus outline without a visible replacement makes keyboard navigation difficult or impossible to follow.
suggestion: Keep the user-agent outline or provide an immediate visible outline, shadow, border, or background in the corresponding focus state.
limitations: Focus selectors are normalized within one CSS or Svelte style block so a matching rule can provide an outline, shadow, border, or background; imported and runtime-generated styles are not resolved.
A :focus:not(:focus-visible) rule is treated as intentional pointer-focus suppression, while a:not([href]) is ignored because it is not keyboard-focusable without another attribute.
